# StreamDek Mobile v2.1.8

*Version code 66*

## Fixed

**Plugin sources that stopped returning anything**
A source could sit in your collection, switched on, and fail every time with "This source is
missing the function StreamDek needs to run it" — which reads as the plugin author's mistake and
was not one. The app keeps each source's code in its own storage, and a sync could leave that
copy empty: the collection document your account holds does not carry the code itself, so every
device refills it locally and re-downloads whatever is missing. Any one of those downloads failing
saved the source with nothing in it, and nothing ever tried again. An empty file loads perfectly
well and simply exports nothing, which is what produced that message. One device had seventy of a
hundred and thirty-one sources stored this way.

A source with no code now downloads it at the moment it is needed and keeps it, so it repairs
itself on first use instead of staying broken until the collection is reinstalled. This is what
the television has always done, which is why the same collection could work there and not here.

**Remember Last Source**
Returning to something you had started opened its details page instead of playing from the source
you used last. Your position and the source that played it are stored together on the device, but
only the position is sent to your account — so every sync replaced the entry with one that had
forgotten the source, leaving Continue Watching nothing to resume from. The source now survives
the round trip, along with the title's running time.

**Stream results printed the same line twice**
Several sources fill both of their text fields with the same string, and both were shown, so those
results took up two lines to say one thing. The second line now appears only when it has something
the first did not. The same fix applies to the source list inside the player.

**Sizes missing from stream results**
A result could show no size in the list and then "5.01 GB" a second later on the loading screen —
it had the size all along. The size badge was tied to StreamDek Formatting, which is off by
default. It now follows only the **Size Badges** switch, and is read from everything the source
sent rather than one field, so it appears for the many sources that put the size in the release
name.

## Improved

**Audio and subtitle tracks are named, not coded**
The track pickers listed "ENG", "FRE", "PT-BR" — the tag the file happened to carry. They now read
English, French, Portuguese. Add-on subtitle results are named the same way, so picking your own
language out of eighty rows no longer means knowing its two-letter code. A tag StreamDek does not
recognise is left exactly as it was written rather than being called "Unknown".

**Update notes read as notes**
Release notes are written as Markdown and were shown as their own punctuation — hashes in front of
every heading, hyphens in front of every bullet, no space between sections. They are now rendered:
headings, lists, emphasis and links, in the update prompt and under **Settings → App Updates**.
